question: Do local affine-residual velocity correlations survive a one-fish conditional factorized baseline?
competing_interpretations: H_cumulant: transition-linked residual signal includes multi-fish pair correlations
H_one_fish: transition-linked pair statistics are explained by shell-conditioned one-fish residual distributions
H_shift_null: shifted event times show comparable cumulant changes
method: fit per-frame affine baseline and compute affine residual velocity
build undirected kNN graph with k=6
condition one-fish residual distributions on 3 radial shells within each frame
compute observed pair statistic, one-fish conditional expectation, and empirical cumulant
compare transition events against 160 shifted-event null replicates

decision.boundary_reading: No observed or empirical-cumulant pair variable survives shifted-event null gates.
